rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is troublesome, bothersome, or irritating.

example.english: The constant traffic jams lately are really trying.
example.traditional: 呢排成日塞車，真係好麻煩。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 seng4 jat6 sak1 ce1 zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Use this specifically when “trying” means psychologically stressful or pressure-inducing.

example.english: Giving a presentation to so many clients is really trying.
example.traditional: 對住咁多客人做簡報，真係好有壓力。
example.jyutping: deoi3 zyu6 gam3 do1 haak3 jan4 zou6 gaan2 bou3 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 aat3 lik6

rows.note: Use this for something arduous or demanding that takes effort to endure.

example.english: Looking after a sick person is very trying.
example.traditional: 照顧病人係一件好辛苦嘅事。
example.jyutping: ziu3 gu3 beng6 jan4 hai6 jat1 gin6 hou2 san1 fu2 ge3 si6
